component.name: ObiPlayer
component.summary: MPD client for people who care about editions and sound quality
Cliente de MPD para quien cuida las ediciones y la calidad de sonido

description.p: ObiPlayer is a music player for MPD, local or remote, built for audiophiles.

ul.li: Album grid, artists, labels, composers and producers, smart playlists, radio and listening statistics
Exact-pressing metadata from MusicBrainz and Discogs, Wikipedia and Last.fm
DR14 dynamic range analysis, waveforms, visualizers and a bit-perfect signal path indicator
Edition comparison with the Loudness War database, synced lyrics, MPRIS media keys
